brand.name: ARXEON
brand.positioning: AI Factory - The fully autonomous business managed by AI. Swiss Quality, Elite, Minimalist.
brand.target_audience: Business owners and entrepreneurs seeking elite efficiency and scalability.

colors.rules: Avoid generic tech-blue or neon. Color exists to highlight hierarchy. Use pure #0A0B0E for structural backgrounds to emulate obsidian. Gold (#D4AF37) is reserved for interactive states (hover), structural hairlines, and key emphasis. Deep Midnight Blue is used as an underlay for glass surfaces.

typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep headings Light or Regular weight in Playfair Display. Overlines and labels must be uppercase IBM Plex Sans with extremely wide letter spacing.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Swiss Grid precision mixed with editorial breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.rules: Never cramp content. Value negative space. Use asymmetry for visual tension. The 13 pillars grid should be dense but separated by thin 1px borders.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#0A0B0E] rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-sm hover:bg-[#E6C981] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-[#D4AF37]/40 rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-sm hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 hover:border-[#D4AF37] transition-all
buttons.glass: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-none px-6 py-3 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors

cards.default: bg-[#111317] border border-white/5 rounded-none p-8 hover:border-[#D4AF37]/30 transition-all duration-500
cards.glass: bg-[#111317]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-none p-8

forms.input: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 rounded-none px-0 py-3 text-white placeholder-white/30 focus:border-[#D4AF37] focus:ring-0 focus:outline-none transition-colors
forms.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-white/50 mb-1 block

interactions_and_motion.hover: Text elements reveal a 1px gold underline from left to right on hover. Cards subtly brighten their border.
interactions_and_motion.scroll: Slow, staggered fade-up reveal for lists (like the 13 Pillars) using Framer Motion.
interactions_and_motion.micro: Subtle grain overlay (fixed pointer-events-none noise texture over the entire page) for tactile editorial feel.
interactions_and_motion.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

global.language_switcher: IT / FR toggle in the header. Default to IT.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use lucide-react for all specified icons.
Use framer-motion for smooth reveal animations (staggerChildren for the 13 Pillars grid).
Add a fixed <div> with a low opacity SVG noise filter pattern overlay to give the entire page an editorial, non-digital tactile texture.
Structure forms using raw HTML inputs customized with Tailwind for a sharp, border-bottom only minimalist aesthetic.
Header must be sticky with backdrop-blur. The ARXEON logo is pure text in Playfair Display.
Follow the typography strict rules: Playfair Display for Headings, IBM Plex Sans for body. Do not default to Inter.
Ensure the IT/FR language toggle works by conditionally rendering text based on a simple React state or context.
Use `data-testid` on all buttons, the language toggle, and form inputs for testing.
Avoid using Shadcn Cards. Use raw `div` with precise tailwind classes defined in guidelines for the ultimate custom premium feel.
